name: Kanojo ga Lez ni Netorareru!? ~Yuri ni Hamatta Koibito o, Oshioki Chinpo de Torimodose!!~
original_name: 彼女がレズに寝取られる!?～百合にハマった恋人を、おしおきチンポで取り戻せ!!～
source:
"We were as happy as we could be."
Jun lived on his own near the university.
Arika attended the same school. They were good friends, and had become lovers.
It was a sweet time, and they spent all of it together. Jun hoped it was forever.

The Change...
One day Arika went out to drink with a group of friends.
Jun was also invited but his schedule did not permit it.
From that day, he began to feel the distance between them as if she was hiding something.
She began to act more aloof.

The New Friend...
Arika was going out with her new best female friend, Azusa.
They seemed more intimate than normal girl friends, a touch here, a look there.
Jun didn't pay it any mind. They were girls, girls did things.

Give Back My Girlfriend!
Azusa had slid right between Arika's legs, opening her slit
and mind to the beauty of girls love. Oh god, what a humiliating blow!
A man's pride is all he has, and to lose it to a more capable woman...!
He has one thing she doesn't. But is it enough to win Arika back!? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE092598.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“我们曾经幸福得无以复加。”
润独自住在大学附近。有梨华在同一所学校就读。两人从好友变成了恋人。那是一段甜蜜的时光，他们形影不离。润希望这份幸福能永远持续下去。

变化……
某天有梨华和一群朋友出去喝酒。润也受到了邀请，但日程不允许。从那天起，他开始感受到两人之间的距离，仿佛她隐瞒着什么。她变得越来越冷淡。

新朋友……
有梨华和新结交的好闺蜜梓走得很近。她们似乎比普通闺蜜更加亲密，这里碰一下，那里含情脉脉地看一眼。润没有在意——她们是女孩子嘛，女孩子之间都会这样。

把女朋友还给我！
梓已经滑入了有梨华的双腿之间，打开了她的缝隙和心扉，让她沉溺于百合之爱。天啊，这是多么屈辱的打击！男人的尊严是他仅有的东西，输给一个更有能力的女人……！他有一样梓没有的东西。但这足以赢回有梨华吗！？

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE092598.html]DLsite English[/url]]
